messages.subject: server messages to client
parts:
Hi!

Is it possible to change a client-side input from server-side?

I would need a selectInput to contain the rows of a .csv file, which is stored on the server side, and the file may changes during the usage of the page. And I would need to change other inputs as well, when the selected value of selectInput changed.

I was looking for solutions, but I had no luck.
Any idea to solve this problem?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: server messages to client
parts:
We are working on some features to make this possible directly. In the meantime, you can use renderUI to (re)create the inputs when the data changes:

http://rstudio.github.com/shiny/tutorial/#dynamic-ui (scroll down to the section on renderUI)
